viewport.measurement_notes: One fixture account/session; route and coverage run separately (current UI has one active source). No application retry or selection refresh. HTTP/1.1; peak offered active includes transport queue, not backend concurrency; connection peak is GotConn through body completion. All requests, including failures, enter overall latency; feature/empty groups include validated successes only. Viewport completion is the batch critical path, never summed request p95. Proposed 3s fetch budget is not browser initial render. API upstream timeout is 5s (502 retained); client timeout is 30s. Local port-forward overhead included; DB/OS caches not flushed, sequential preflight warms tiles; full source geometry remains unchanged. Collector owns health/resource/telemetry overlap.

limitations: One cold source capability per mode; server, database and OS caches are not flushed.
Test-only React ref traversal obtains the existing map; public MapLibre methods replace source tiles without changing product code.
Source load and idle observations are not time-to-usable-render; no 3-second product render pass is inferred.
Remote shared Chromium scheduling/software rendering and a single run are not a production benchmark.
Viewport request p95 budget is provisional and viewport-fetch 3s budget is proposed, not product render acceptance.
Only five batches per concurrency/source: coarse pilot viewport p95, not a stable SLO.
Go HTTP/1.1 concurrent requests include local port-forward overhead; offered/connection peaks are not measured backend concurrency.
Serial reads and source-loader browser observation use the same namespace, but are separate measurement windows.
Browser route tile coordinates may differ from the Go z14 model; see browser_observation_findings. Missing CDP protocol is explicitly marked.
No resource-capped matcher backlog, extra users, full browser matrix, or product initial-render timing was run.
Host Prometheus 19090 not forwarded: resource utilization peaks are unavailable, not configured limits.
Browser observation errors are retained; source-loader success is not claimed.
